issues.title: Dynamic Imports don't resolve when using package.json#imports
issues.body:
### Describe the bug

In SvelteKit 3.0 we are deprecating the alias `$lib` (which uses `resolve.alias` under the hood) in favour of a platform feature: `package.json#imports`.

You can define this in your package.json

```json
{
	"imports": {
		"#lib/*": "./src/lib/*"
	}
}
```
and it basically acts as an alias (you can do `import("#lib/my-file.js")` at whatever nesting level and it will resolve correctly).

The base import works fine but where it fails is when you are using dynamic imports with vite:

```ts
// this will fail
await import(`#lib/${folder_name}/index.ts`);

// the same with alias works fine
await import(`$lib/${folder_name}/index.ts`);

// same if I import using a relative path
await import(`../../lib/${folder_name}/index.ts`);
```

given the rest works fine this feels like a bug worth addressing.

### Reproduction

https://stackblitz.com/edit/vitejs-vite-pj6f16ta?file=vite.config.ts,src%2Fmain.js,package.json,src%2Flib%2Falias%2Fa%2Findex.ts,src%2Flib%2Falias%2Fb%2Findex.ts,src%2Flib%2Fimportmaps%2Fa%2Findex.ts,src%2Flib%2Fimportmaps%2Fb%2Findex.ts&terminal=dev

### Steps to reproduce

1. open the playground
2. run the app
3. check that you get a warning in terminal the console
4. try to press the "load alias" button and verify it works
5. try to press the "load import without importmaps" and verify it works
6. try to press the "load import" and verify it doesn't work

### System Info

```shell
repl
```

### Used Package Manager

npm

evidence.body: I think we should use the same function with the `resolve` option passed to `nativeDynamicImportVarsPlugin` so that the resolution is consistent for dev and build.
